title: System, Method, and Cryptographic Protocol for Bridge-Free Trilateral Multi-Rail Settlement with Post-Quantum Hash-Attested State Anchoring and Canonical Instruction Introspection
description: A technical disclosure and defensive patent specification for the SynapticChain Bridge-Free Trilateral Native Multi-Rail Settlement Protocol and WOTS+ Sovereign Shield. Eliminates cross-chain wrapped asset bridges and custodial smart contract honeypots by executing native base-asset settlement across Solana (Token-2022 RequiredMemoTransfers with consensus abort 0x24), XRP Ledger (DENSE-16 SHAMap memo transactions), and SynapticChain L1 (256-lane SCBFT sovereign consensus). Anchors trilateral clearing states against Shor's quantum cryptanalysis using a 67-chain Winternitz One-Time Signature (WOTS+, RFC 8391) post-quantum checkpoint leaf bound to continuous multilateral netting windows. Establishes absolute defensive prior art under 35 U.S.C. § 102(a)(1) and EPC Article 54(2).
